judged_text: PollFeed has no per-item error handling: i.content.scrub raises NoMethodError for feeds lacking an Atom-style <content> element (plain RSS 2.0 uses description/content:encoded), nil titles hit the PostCreator NOT NULL constraint, URI(url) raises for URLs passing the loose /^https?\:\/\// guard, and URLs longer than the 255-char embed_url column raise on insert — any of these aborts the items loop mid-feed, and with retry: false and hourly recurrence the job re-fails at the same item every hour with no rescue or logging

adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the loop does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` and then `TopicEmbed.import(user, url, i.title, content)` with no per-item rescue. If a feed item lacks `content` (common for RSS 2.0 which may use `description`/`content:encoded`), `i.content` can be `nil` and `nil.scrub` will raise `NoMethodError`, aborting the entire job mid-feed. Additionally, `TopicEmbed.import` only guards URLs with `/^https?\:\/\//`, but then calls `absolutize_urls(url, contents)` which does `URI(url)` without rescue; a syntactically invalid URL that still matches the regex would raise and similarly kill the job. Given `sidekiq_options retry: false` and hourly recurrence, the scheduled job would keep failing on the problematic item without progressing or logging.
